name: Hermes Local Runtime Wrapper
actions: clone an explicitly configured external Hermes source on an explicit install command
start an explicitly configured command from the cloned external folder
serve loopback-only health, consent, and module status
create consent-gated local task, review-proposal, and prompt-pack files
summary: Explicit-config bootstrap plus a loopback, consent-gated local proposal service for an external Hermes Agent installation.
notes: AXM does not bundle Hermes or connect this control layer to it yet. The source example is configuration, not live source, license, installation, readiness, identity binding, sandbox, or runtime proof. Bootstrap install/start is explicit but separate from the control-layer consent toggle.
